title: 第155章 金字塔尖（论坛体）
slug: 电竞世界冠军选秀c位出道

第(1/3)页

-[闪耀计划闪耀了吗]论坛

#三公正式结束了，对于三公排名大家有什么看法？以及明天的顺位发布大家觉得第一会是谁？#

【1L：楼主你有没有觉得第二个问题特别幽默？】

【2L：可以直接把结尾的问号删掉换成江执屿。】

【3L：我严重怀疑楼主第二个问题是来骗回复的，你江第一次顺位发布就断层坐稳第一了有人还记得吗……】

——回复：【是啊，现在很多人拿他是River参加选秀就是降维打击来酸，闭口不提没人知道他是谁的时候，他早就已经坐稳金字塔尖的王座了。】

——回复：【这种从零开始也能一路杀疯的剧情太戳我这种慕强批了。】

【289L：回归正题，三公结果里我最意外的是江执屿票数，最不意外的也是江执屿票数。】

——回复：【懂你意思。】

——回复：【领先那么多真是有点太夸张了，请求查询安俊英队心理阴影面积。】

——回复：【笑不活了，安俊英在后采的时候说，有对票数差做心理准备了的，但还是被惊到了。】

【290L：林森和米蓝票数缠缠绵绵我理解，毕竟在场大部分是江丝，肯定会对310组有点端水。我不太理解的是隗双组竟然会比邓苏水组高那么多，邓苏水还和江执屿同队过哎。】

——回复：【邓苏水虽然和江执屿同队过，但是整个公演阶段存在感都很低哎，反而是隗双看着和江执屿熟很多。】

——回复：【隗双那次抱着江执屿冲去医院给他拉了很多好感吧，江丝顺手就投了。】

——回复：【但是邓苏水也真是很神奇的体质哎，作为节目开始前人气最高的演员身份进组，结果全程下来都像是在自嗨，不仅不出圈没热梗，排名也在一直掉。】

——回复：【其实本质还是和江皇不熟……细心的人会发现现在那些粉丝吹逼的人气“逆袭”选手都是因为和江皇走得近，然后才热度飞涨。】

Page (1/3)

-[Is the Shining Plan Shining?] Forum

#三公 is officially over, what do you think of the ranking of 三公?And who do you think will be the first in tomorrow's announcement?#

[1L: Owner, do you think the second question is particularly humorous?】

[2L: You can just delete the question mark at the end and replace it with Jiang Zhiyu.】

[3L: I seriously suspect that the second question of the poster is here to trick you into replying. You Jiang failed to secure the first place after the first announcement. Does anyone still remember...]

——Reply: [Yes, many people are now complaining that River's participation in the draft is a dimensionality reduction blow. If no one knows who he is, he has already secured his throne at the top of the pyramid.】

——Reply: [This kind of plot where you can kill people all the way from scratch is too annoying for a fan like me.】

[289L: Back to the topic, what surprised me the most among the three official results was the number of Jiang Zhiyu votes, and the least surprising thing was also the number of Jiang Zhiyu votes.】

——Reply: [I understand what you mean.】

——Reply: [It’s a bit exaggerated to be so far ahead. Please check the psychological shadow area of Ahn Junying’s team.】

——Reply: [I couldn’t stop laughing. Ahn Joon Young said during the post-report that some people were mentally prepared for the difference in votes, but they were still shocked.】

[290L: I understand the entanglement between Lin Sen and Mi Lan’s votes. After all, most of the people present are Jiang Si, so they will definitely be a little skeptical of the 310 group.What I don't quite understand is that Wei's double team is so much higher than Deng Sushui's team. Deng Sushui even played in the same team as Jiang Zhiyu.】

——Reply: [Although Deng Sushui and Jiang Zhiyu were in the same team, his presence was very low throughout the performance stage. On the contrary, Wei Shuang seemed to be much familiar with Jiang Zhiyu.】

——Reply: [The time when Wei Shuang rushed to the hospital with Jiang Zhiyu in his arms, he must have gained a lot of favor from him, so Jiang Si voted in easily.】

——Reply: [But Deng Su Shui also has a really amazing physique. As the most popular actor before the show started, he joined the cast, but it turned out that he was just enjoying himself throughout the whole process. Not only did he not get out of the circle, he was not popular, but his ranking also kept falling.】

——Reply: [In fact, he is still not familiar with Jiang Huang... Careful people will find that the popular "counterattack" players promoted by fans now are all because of their close relationship with Jiang Huang, and then their popularity soared.】
